text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Manhattan Cafe invited me
to visit a shrine with her, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Um, is something the matter...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Cafe...
No, it's nothing major, really...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... um... wherever I go,
UFO sightings always seem to pop up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe a UFO will come to this shrine where we trained yesterday, too...
Thinking that, I came to check it out early this morning, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... As expected, rumors are just rumors.
It seems I was worrying over nothing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
I'll be getting back to my training now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...They have departed...
However, the atmosphere here feels less like a UFO and more like—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then, a blinding light enveloped the area!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer…….

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...Please rest assured... 'they' have no intention of causing any harm......"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, so I'm the only one
who can hear this voice, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, she continued her dialogue
with the invisible "them"—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It seems... they were satisfied with what I shared, and have let me go...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...It seems to be an academic survey, so... I don't think it's harmful... In fact, she even helped improve my physical condition..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I don't understand what that phenomenon just now was... but she seems to be having a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I hope someday...
the time comes when I can thank them in person...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the next moment, the dazzling light rapidly shrank away...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text: Ah... excuse me! Could you, like, back up just a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
"We're currently filming for TV.
Sorry for the trouble...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The mysterious light turned out to be a light used for filming...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought there was a chance, but
it's a shame..."
